WITH near_lines AS (
  SELECT id, source_id, transport_type, route_ref, name, geom, fetched_at
  FROM transit_lines
  WHERE ST_DWithin( AND transport_type = ANY(%(transport_types)s)
      geom,
      ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(%(lng)s, %(lat)s), 4326)::geography,
      %(anchor_radius_m)s
    )
),
candidate AS (
  SELECT
    l.id AS listing_id, l.sreality_id, l.price_czk, l.area_m2,
    measure_price_per_m2(l.price_czk::numeric, l.area_m2::numeric, l.category_main, l.category_type) AS price_per_m2,
    measure_price_per_m2_basis(l.category_main, l.category_type) AS price_per_m2_basis,
    l.category_main, l.category_type, l.area_basis,
    l.disposition, ll.okres_name AS district,
    l.floor, l.total_floors,
    l.building_type, l.condition, l.energy_rating,
    l.has_balcony, l.has_lift, l.has_parking,
    ST_Distance(
      ll.geom::geography,
      ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(%(lng)s, %(lat)s), 4326)::geography
    ) AS distance_m,
    l.first_seen_at, l.last_seen_at,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM (now() - l.last_seen_at))::int AS data_age_days,
    nl.source_id      AS nearest_line_source_id,
    nl.transport_type AS nearest_line_transport_type,
    nl.route_ref      AS nearest_line_route_ref,
    ST_Distance(ll.geom::geography, nl.geom) AS corridor_distance_m,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.id
      ORDER BY ST_Distance(ll.geom::geography, nl.geom)
    ) AS rn
  FROM listings l
  JOIN listing_location ll ON ll.listing_id = l.id
  JOIN near_lines nl
    ON ST_DWithin(ll.geom::geography, nl.geom, %(corridor_m)s)
  WHERE (case when l.is_active then greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch from (now() - l.first_seen_at)) / 86400)::int) else greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch from (l.last_seen_at - l.first_seen_at)) / 86400)::int) end) <= %(tom_days_max)s AND (case when l.is_active then greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch from (now() - l.first_seen_at)) / 86400)::int) else greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch from (l.last_seen_at - l.first_seen_at)) / 86400)::int) end) >= %(tom_days_min)s AND (l.furnished = ANY(%(furnished)s) OR (l.furnished IS NULL OR NOT (l.furnished = ANY(%(furnished_canon)s)))) AND (l.ownership = ANY(%(ownership)s) OR (l.ownership IS NULL OR NOT (l.ownership = ANY(%(ownership_canon)s)))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM properties canon_p WHERE canon_p.id = l.property_id AND canon_p.repr_listing_ref_id = l.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM listing_fetch_failures lff WHERE lff.sreality_id = l.sreality_id AND lff.given_up = true) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM listings subj WHERE subj.id = ANY(%(exclude_listing_ids)s) AND subj.property_id = l.property_id) AND l.apartment_condition_level <= %(apartment_condition_level_max)s AND l.apartment_condition_level >= %(apartment_condition_level_min)s AND l.area_m2 BETWEEN %(area_min)s AND %(area_max)s AND l.building_condition_level <= %(building_condition_level_max)s AND l.building_condition_level >= %(building_condition_level_min)s AND l.building_type = ANY(%(building_type_match)s) AND l.category_main = %(category_main)s AND l.category_sub_cb = %(category_sub_cb)s AND l.category_type = %(category_type)s AND l.cellar = %(cellar)s AND l.condition = ANY(%(condition_match)s) AND l.disposition = ANY(%(disposition_loose)s) AND l.energy_rating = ANY(%(energy_rating_match)s) AND l.first_seen_at <= now() - make_interval(days => %(first_seen_min_days)s) AND l.first_seen_at >= now() - make_interval(days => %(first_seen_max_days)s) AND l.floor BETWEEN %(floor_min)s AND %(floor_max)s AND l.garage = %(garage)s AND l.garden_area <= %(max_garden_area)s AND l.garden_area >= %(min_garden_area)s AND l.has_balcony = %(has_balcony)s AND l.has_lift = %(has_lift)s AND l.has_parking = %(has_parking)s AND l.is_active = true AND l.last_seen_at <= now() - make_interval(days => %(last_seen_min_days)s) AND l.last_seen_at > now() - make_interval(days => %(max_age_days)s) AND l.last_seen_at >= now() - make_interval(days => %(last_seen_max_days)s) AND l.parking_lots >= %(min_parking_lots)s AND l.price_czk <= %(max_price_czk)s AND l.price_czk >= %(min_price_czk)s AND l.source = ANY(%(portals)s) AND l.terrace = %(terrace)s AND l.usable_area <= %(max_usable_area)s AND l.usable_area >= %(min_usable_area)s AND ll.geom IS NOT NULL AND measure_price_per_m2(l.price_czk::numeric, l.area_m2::numeric, l.category_main, l.category_type) <= %(max_price_per_m2)s AND measure_price_per_m2(l.price_czk::numeric, l.area_m2::numeric, l.category_main, l.category_type) >= %(min_price_per_m2)s AND plot_area_m2(l.category_main, l.area_m2::numeric, l.estate_area::numeric) <= %(max_estate_area)s AND plot_area_m2(l.category_main, l.area_m2::numeric, l.estate_area::numeric) >= %(min_estate_area)s
)
SELECT *
FROM candidate
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY corridor_distance_m
LIMIT 500
